systems_found: University of North Carolina System (17 institutions + System Office)
North Carolina Community College System (58 colleges)

sources.institution: UNC System Office and all constituent institutions
sources.coverage_years: Current quarterly snapshot only (page states data current as of September 30, 2026)
sources.institutions_covered: UNC System Office plus the 16 universities and NC School of Science and Math; excludes UNC Health Care and UNC Press
sources.employees: permanent employees (faculty, SHRA and EHRA staff); temporary employees not included
sources.size: not stated (roughly 50,000+ permanent employees system-wide, estimate)
sources.terms: not stated; page says the data is a point-in-time snapshot and may not reflect all funding sources
sources.blocker: Gated behind a POSTed 'Click to Access' agreement form, then search-driven results; no published bulk file. Not submitted per instructions.
sources.notes: Best and only official system-wide source. The gate is just a click-through (button name=action value=agree, POST to index.php), so if clicking through is acceptable this probably becomes a scrapable B (results tables by campus). The UNC Health Sciences Library FAQ says results for individual departments can be downloaded, which I could not verify without passing the gate. No historical snapshots exposed on the landing page.

sources.institution: State agencies paid through NC Integrated HR-Payroll System
sources.system: State of North Carolina (Office of the State Controller)
sources.institutions_covered: none of the universities or community colleges (explicitly excluded)
sources.notes: Listed only to record that it does NOT cover higher ed: page says community college employees and university employees are not paid through the system.

sources.blocker: Site returns HTTP 403 with a bot 'Client Challenge' page; search-only, no bulk download.

private_extra: None found. Duke, Wake Forest, Davidson etc. publish only IRS 990 compensation.
gaps: No bulk file or API for the UNC System; only the current quarterly snapshot, no history; no pay beyond base salary (no overtime/other/total pay). No published person-level pay for the 58 community colleges (excluded from the state OSC database; would require public records requests to each college). The News & Observer / Charlotte Observer 'UNC System Workers' salary database is mentioned by a UNC library FAQ but appears paywalled/stale and I could not confirm a current URL.
notes: Did not submit the UNC click-through form, per the no-forms rule, so rated C even though it is probably the best NC source. Did not try individual campus HR sites because all UNC campuses feed the system database. OpenTheBooks blocked by an anti-bot challenge; I recorded it and did not attempt to bypass.
